claims.statement: Under fpt/ghec, this fragment requires user OAuth workflow scope plus repository write/admin permission for workflow modification. Preserve parent App/authentication context; do not infer universal exclusion of other credential types or authorize workflow writes.

Installation authentication uses an App JWT and the correct installation ID obtained from webhook or installation APIs; enterprise lookup requires App installations under its feature conditional. The source's settings paragraph switches to App ID, which differs from client ID and is not interchangeable with installation ID.

Installation-token request repositories/repository_ids optionally restrict access, up to 500 repositories, never beyond installation grants; omitted scope uses all granted repositories. Permission narrowing likewise cannot exceed grants, but enterprise installation tokens cannot be narrowed and retain all granted enterprise permissions.

Response includes token, expiry, permissions and applicable repositories; installation token lifetime is one hour. API version and authentication syntax depend on contextual variables/includes. Commands are examples, not authorized token minting, secure secret handling or live capability receipts.
